properties.name: tunnel
properties.notes: digitised from a written description; not a survey
properties.quote: The lower tunnel enters quartzite 550 feet below and 1,350 feet northeast of the upper, strikes a fracture zone, and except for incidental departures follows it southeastward for nearly 800 feet The zone trends N. 10° to 20° W. and dips westward at angles ranging from 65° to 80°, the average being 70°, and varies in thickness from a close fissure to 4 feet For the greater portion of its course it lies within quartzite walls and carries stained ocherous material.
